snippet.title: Meadgard - Demo Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The Meadgard Demo is coming to Steam this August! 🍺 Wishlist now: https://tinyurl.com/457skubt

Run a Viking tavern with your friends in this chaotic co-op adventure for 1-4 players. Hunt mythical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

Download the free Steam demo this August and test your tavern management skills before the official launch!

Follow our socials to join the Meadgard community & get all the latest news! 

📱Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oddikogames/
🦋BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/oddikogames.bsky.social
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@meadgard
